mapper.sql: ( SELECT s1.* FROM t_gigab2b_product_snapshot s1 INNER JOIN ( SELECT sku, SUBSTRING_INDEX( GROUP_CONCAT(id ORDER BY (CASE WHEN IFNULL(price,0) > 0 OR IFNULL(discounted_price,0) > 0 OR IFNULL(exclusive_price,0) > 0 THEN 2 WHEN price_json IS NOT NULL AND price_json NOT IN ('', '{}', 'null') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) DESC, (CASE WHEN detail_json IS NOT NULL AND JSON_LENGTH(JSON_EXTRACT(detail_json,'$.imageUrls')) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) DESC, sync_time DESC ), ',', 1 ) AS best_id FROM t_gigab2b_product_snapshot WHERE detail_json IS NOT NULL GROUP BY sku ) bx ON bx.best_id = s1.id )

( SELECT l1.* FROM t_gigab2b_product_list l1 INNER JOIN ( SELECT sku, SUBSTRING_INDEX(GROUP_CONCAT(id ORDER BY sync_time DESC, id DESC), ',', 1) AS best_id FROM t_gigab2b_product_list GROUP BY sku ) lx ON lx.best_id = l1.id )

l.id AS id, l.sku AS sku, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(s.detail_json, '$.mpn')) AS itemCode, COALESCE(NULLIF(l.product_name, ''), s.product_name, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(s.detail_json, '$.productName'))) AS name, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(s.detail_json, '$.category')) AS categoryName, CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(s.detail_json, '$.categoryCode')) AS UNSIGNED) AS gigaCategoryId, COALESCE( NULLIF(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(s.detail_json, '$.mainImageUrl')), ''), JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(s.detail_json, '$.imageUrls[0]')) ) AS imageUrl, JSON_EXTRACT(s.detail_json, '$.imageUrls') AS imageUrlsJson, IFNULL(JSON_LENGTH(JSON_EXTRACT(s.detail_json, '$.imageUrls')), 0) AS imageCount, COALESCE( NULLIF(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(s.detail_json, '$.description')), ''), JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(s.detail_json, '$.characteristics')) ) AS description, COALESCE( NULLIF(s.seller_available_inventory, 0), NULLIF(s.buyer_available_inventory, 0), CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(s.inventory_json, '$.sellerInventoryInfo.sellerAvailableInventory')) AS SIGNED), CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(s.inventory_json, '$.buyerInventoryInfo.totalBuyerAvailableInventory')) AS SIGNED), CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(s.inventory_json, '$.sellerAvailableInventory')) AS SIGNED), CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(s.inventory_json, '$.buyerAvailableInventory')) AS SIGNED), 0 ) AS qtyAvailable, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(s.detail_json, '$.sellerInfo.sellerCode')) AS supplierCode, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(s.detail_json, '$.sellerInfo.sellerStore')) AS supplierName, COALESCE( NULLIF(s.price, 0), CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(s.price_json, '$.price')) AS DECIMAL(14,4)) ) AS price, COALESCE( NULLIF(s.exclusive_price, 0), CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(s.price_json, '$.exclusivePrice')) AS DECIMAL(14,4)) ) AS exclusivePrice, COALESCE( NULLIF(s.discounted_price, 0), CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(s.price_json, '$.discountedPrice')) AS DECIMAL(14,4)) ) AS discountedPrice, COALESCE(s.currency, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(s.price_json, '$.currency')), 'USD') AS currency, s.sku_available AS skuAvailable, CASE WHEN JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(s.detail_json, '$.newArrivalFlag')) IN ('1', 'true', 'TRUE') THEN 'Listed Today' ELSE NULL END AS listedTag, COALESCE(l.sync_time, l.create_date, s.sync_time) AS createTime, CONCAT('Giga/', IFNULL(l.source_platform, 'giga')) AS remark
FROM l INNER JOIN s ON s.sku = l.sku
